'''Ancient seeds''' are items dropped by killing [[Greydwarf Brute]]s and destroying [[Greydwarf Nest]]s. 

== Usage ==
=== Crafting ===
* {{item link|Heart of the Forest}}

=== Summoning ===
* A total of three Ancient Seeds are required to summon [[The Elder]]. See [[Forsaken Altars]].

== Notes ==
* They resemble a seed, with green growths stemming into a mace-like formation.
* They cannot be planted, and they are unrelated to [[Ancient Tree]]s.
